title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max reach stores Friday amid shipping slippage
summary: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launch in stores on Friday 19 September in more than 65 countries after pre-orders opened on Saturday 13 September, but shipping estimates have slipped across major US carriers. Apple's own online store lists iPhone 18 Pro delivery dates of 30 September to 7 October and Pro Max dates of 7 to 14 October across all colours and storage tiers, while Verizon is shipping 18 September through 6 October for nearly every configuration. Pro and Pro Max come in black, silver, glacier and a new burgundy finish, from $1,199 and $1,299.
